messages:
Aisha: Heads-up 1 final GA readiness thread for Predictor v1. Target GA date Mon 2026-04-06. Need explicit OKs on SLA, docs, support runbooks, monitoring thresholds, and pricing guardrails by EOD Fri. Please call out any hidden dependencies.

Tom: SLA/infra check 1: proposing 99.95% monthly availability and p99 latency <= 700ms for hosted Standard. Load test shows steady p99 ~680ms at expected QPS on canary. One flaky node in region eu-west still causing small availability dips; infra will cordon and replace tonight.

Nina: Docs status 1: quickstart, API reference, and migration notes are drafted. Missing: explicit examples for model-pin, cache-control headers, and billing samples. I'll add those tomorrow AM and request copy review.

Evan: Monitoring/oncall 1: alerts created and routed to predictor-pager. Current page rule: p99 > 800ms for 2m. Suggest lowering to 750ms to capture regressions without increasing noise. Also added SLI dashboards for cache hit rate, token cost per request, and tail error types.

Priya: Support & Billing 1: support playbook and runbook skeleton ready. Outstanding: billing dispute template and SLA credit calc doc. Recommend enabling auto-tagging for billing cases to reduce triage time. Can ship GA with manual credit process for first 30 days.

Aisha: Pricing/Commercial note 1: recommend GA list price unchanged from beta, with a temporary "early-burst buffer" of 2% free token credit for new orgs in first month to avoid accidental overage friction. Need legal to approve promo copy. Sales asked for a committed-capacity pilot option; Pete from Sales has a deck.

Tom: Hidden blocker 1: dependency on redis cluster upgrade for sticky prefix cache metrics; upgrade scheduled Thu night. If it slips, cache-related regressions might not be visible in metrics.

Nina: Copy review request 1: pinging @content for final wording on pricing examples and model-pin caveats.

Evan: PD tuning ack 1: I'll change PD threshold to p99 > 750ms over 3m and keep an honor-level Slack alert at p99 > 900ms. Also adding a runbook step: if cache hit rate < 70% trigger investigation play.

Priya: Billing runbook plan 1: I'll draft the template and link to ticket by Thu EOD. For SLA credits we'll do manual calculation this month and automate in Q2.

billing-bot: Billing alert test scheduled for Thu 03:00 UTC.

Aisha: OK summary 1: blockers: redis upgrade, legal promo copy, content copy review. Owners please respond with explicit OK or list new blockers. If all OK, I'll create release ticket and draft customer comms.

Tom: infra OK pending redis upgrade (tracking) 1: :white_check_mark:

Nina: docs OK pending content review 1: :white_check_mark:

Evan: monitoring/oncall OK 1: :white_check_mark:

Priya: support/billing OK will deliver runbook Thu EOD 1: :white_check_mark:

Aisha: legal pinged for promo copy 1: looping in @legal. If legal clears by Fri AM we lock GA.

release-bot: Draft release created: https://release.redwood/predictor-v1/1789000123 1: status: draft.

Evan: small ask: add an SLO for availability incident latency (time to restore) measurement in postmortem template.

Aisha: Good call 1: adding that to the runbook checklist. Thanks team :rocket:
